feat: kinetic redesign, expert curriculum v2, and Deep Field worlds (#34)

## Summary

Three major arcs, reviewed iteratively on localhost:

### 1. Kinetic redesign + stack upgrade
- React 19, Tailwind 4, latest deps; visual system overhaul (Space
Grotesk + JetBrains Mono, volt accent)
- Playwright e2e suite; perf gates kept (420 kB critical-path budget)

### 2. Expert curriculum v2 — 140 steps, 3 distinct tracks
- **Builder** (clinical trials, 44 steps): schema design, constraints,
dirty-data cleanup, transactions, triggers, JSON
- **Analyst** (trading, 45 steps): joins, set ops, subqueries, full
window-function arsenal, capstones
- **Optimizer** (space logistics, 51 steps): recursive CTEs, EXPLAIN
QUERY PLAN, index design, trigger caches
- Validation engine v2: result-set matching vs canonical solutions,
hidden-variant shadow DB (kills hardcoded answers), PLAN_VERIFY,
deterministic seeded data
- Certification exams (8 questions, no hints, ≥6/8 to pass) with
persisted certifications
- Curriculum integrity suite mechanically proves every step solvable,
every fix-starter failing, every exam solvable

### 3. Deep Field — unified homepage + per-world theming
- Single homepage triptych (The Lab / The Floor / The Belt) replaces
landing + mission select
- Real lazy-loaded sql.js playground on the homepage
- Full in-app re-theme via `[data-world]` CSS tokens
- three.js background (240 kB) replaced by a 2 kB canvas atmosphere

## Verification
- lint, tsc clean; 73 unit/integration tests; 3 e2e journeys
- Bundle 402.7 kB / 420 kB budget; Lighthouse perf 66 / a11y 98 / bp 100
(TBT 0 ms, CLS 0)
